# See docs/contracts/agent-user-schema.md.

# Agent config — volatile runtime artefacts (machine-generated,
# regenerated on demand, never committed). Covers price cache,
# council artefacts, council events log, and hook runtime state.
# Individual paths are listed explicitly below for documentation;
# the `/agents/runtime/` prefix is the catch-all.
/agents/runtime/

# Agent config — AI Council price table (refreshed weekly, never commit)
/agents/runtime/.agent-prices.md

# Agent config — AI Council artefacts (questions, responses, sessions).
# Dev-time scratch — informs decisions, never the durable contract.
# See ai-council § Output path convention.
/agents/runtime/council/questions/
/agents/runtime/council/responses/
/agents/runtime/council/sessions/

# Agent config — AI Council persistent events log.
# Local JSONL audit trail for necessity / quota decisions. Hashes
# original_ask before write but is still considered private. Set
# AGENT_CONFIG_NO_EVENTS_LOG=1 to disable writes entirely.
/agents/runtime/council/events.log

# Agent config — Tier 1 hook runtime state (context-hygiene.json,
# onboarding-gate.json). Written by SessionStart / PostToolUse hooks
# on Augment + Claude Code; regenerated on demand, never commit.
/agents/runtime/state/

# Agent config — unified-setup wizard partial state (Roadmap R2 Phase 1).
